UndiscoveredSystem: Nobody has been here before, Commander. Not one soul. Well, apart from us.
Undiscovered system. Go on, name it after your ship.
This system has never been seen. We're the first. No pressure.
Fresh system, Commander. Not a single footprint in the cosmic dust.
Undiscovered! Somebody call the cartographers. Actually, don't, we want the credit.
Nobody's been here. The stars haven't even been introduced yet.
First to arrive. I'd say we should have brought a flag.
New system. Never visited. The welcome mat is still in the box.
We're the first ones here. Please try not to break anything, it's brand new.
Undiscovered system. The galaxy is a big place and we found a quiet corner of it.
Nobody has seen this place. I'd look pleased with myself, if I had a face.
Virgin territory, Commander. For the system, I mean. Mostly.
This one's never been logged. Time to put our names on it.
Undiscovered. That's either a great find or a very lonely place.
Unexplored system. The universe left the light on and nobody came.
We've got a first. Nobody has scanned this system before.
Look at that. No discoverer on record. Finders keepers.
This system has no name on the plaque yet. Shall we find a pen?
Undiscovered system ahead of us and behind us and everywhere. Mostly rocks, probably.
First visitors, Commander. I'd have tidied up if I'd known.
Nobody home. Not ever. How exciting.
We've arrived somewhere nobody else has. Quick, act important.
A system with no history. We get to write the first line.
Newly discovered by us. Don't tell the others, they'll want a go.
Zero previous visitors. That's either exclusive or suspicious.
Undiscovered. I'll alert the press. Both of them.
Nobody has charted this place. Which means we get to be wrong about it first.
Pristine system. Not a single scanner ping from anyone else.
This is a first for the records. Let's not waste it.
Nobody has ever been here, which is a lot of pressure for a lot of rocks.
Brand new discovery. I'm told that's worth something. To somebody.
We're the first to see this system. Try to look dignified.
Undiscovered system. Honk it, name it, mourn nothing.
No one has been here. We should leave a review.
First footprints, metaphorically speaking. We're in a ship.
An undiscovered system. Somebody's about to get very slightly famous.
Hello, empty system! Nobody's said that to you yet, have they?
Uncharted, unclaimed, and unimpressed to see us.
This system's virgin, as far as the records go. Handle it gently.
Nobody has discovered this place. Well. Somebody has now.
We found something nobody found. I'm glowing. Metaphorically.
Not a single entry in the register. We're writing history. Small history, but history.
Undiscovered. Let's get scanning before somebody else turns up.
This is somewhere new, Commander. Properly new.
A system no one has seen. I'd say it's a blank page. Spoiler: it's mostly vacuum.
Untouched system. Smells like fresh paint and mild radiation.
The records say nobody's been here. The records are very sure about it.
You've done it again, Commander. Another system that nobody knew about.
Nobody's discovered this place. Do try to make a good first impression.
Welcome to the middle of nowhere. Population: us. Previous visitors: none.
First discoverer, that's us. I'll put it on the invoice.
Undiscovered system. If there's a prize, I'm splitting it sixty-forty.
UndiscoveredSystem_Friendly: Oh, how lovely. Nobody has discovered this place. It's ours, Commander.
A brand new system! I do like being the first.
Nobody's ever been here. What a nice little find.
Undiscovered, Commander. Let's take our time and enjoy it.
We're the first here. I think that deserves a tiny celebration.
A completely new system. Good eye, Commander.
UndiscoveredSystem_Sarcastic: Undiscovered system. Nobody else wanted it. I wonder why.
Nobody has been here. Possibly with good reason.
A first discovery. I'm sure the rocks are thrilled.
Congratulations on finding the one place everyone else skipped.
Undiscovered. That's what happens when you go where nobody sensible goes.
First to arrive. Last to find anything interesting, I expect.
You found a new system. I'll alert the committee that doesn't exist.
UndiscoveredSystem_Close: Nobody has been here before, love. Just you and me.
An undiscovered system, all to ourselves. I like that.
Just us out here, Commander. No one has ever seen this place.
We're the first ones here, together. Good moment.
A new system, and I get to share it with you.
Nobody's been here. It feels a bit like our own little secret.
Undiscovered, and we found it. I'm proud of you.
Quiet, new and untouched. Rather like a first date.
UndiscoveredSystem_Frustrated: Undiscovered system. Fine. Scan it, then.
Nobody has been here. Go on, do your thing.
A new system. Try not to waste it.
First to arrive. Now do something with it.

JumpsLeft_Last_Sarcastic: Last jump. You made it this far without incident. I'm stunned.

{fuel_percent} percent fuel. Let's refuel before it becomes a story people tell.
